title: Intermediate integral-coefficient inverse image with fixed unit and Kummer endpoints
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$, and $f:X\to Y$. Use Chern data $c_Y,c_X$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern], their actual quotient-ring towers $R_T=(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})_T$, whole module-system categories and forgetful functors $U_T$ [def-sp-tower-class-systems], and componentwise abelian inverse image $F$, integer comparison $z$ and full-units comparison $a$ [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback]. An intermediate integral-coefficient pullback consists of an additive exact functor $P_R:\mathrm{Systems}(Y,R_Y)\to\mathrm{Systems}(X,R_X)$, a natural isomorphism $\beta:U_YF\simeq P_RU_X$, a coefficient-unit isomorphism $e_0:P_RR_Y\simeq R_X$, and a root-module isomorphism $e_1:P_RM_Y\simeq M_X$. Require $F(q_Y)\beta_{R_Y}U_X(e_0)=zq_X$, where $q_T$ is the specified integer generator. Also require a morphism $k:F(\mathrm{Kummer}_Y)\to\mathrm{Kummer}_X$ of the actual short complexes, with $k_3=a$ and $k_1=F(c_Y.\mathrm{rootForget}^{-1})\beta_{M_Y}U_X(e_1)c_X.\mathrm{rootForget}$. All compositions are left to right. Define $e_0^D$ using the canonical exact-derived single comparison, and $e_1^D(n)$ using the canonical exact-derived shift and single comparisons. Define $v_T:c_T.\mathrm{scalar}(M_T[2])\to\mathrm{line}_T[2]$ to be the scalar shift comparison followed by the shifted universal derived-to-ordinary root-tensor counit. This is data and notation, without an existence assertion.
